title: Simpatico

location.series: Pentagram / The Public Theater case study

slide_intent: Use extreme scale and cropping deliberately because letter fragments can become an image as well as a word.
strategic_value: The monumental black-and-white title can make this production conspicuous within a typographic brand.
demonstration: Huge SIMPATICO letterforms occupy nearly the whole poster; narrow gray-and-red credit strips cut vertically through them.
practical_value: Compare oversized title texture with a separate narrow channel for supporting details.

content_islands.name: Title field
content_islands.spec: Fill the white poster with stacked, cropped black letterforms.

content_islands.name: Credit strips
content_islands.spec: Thread narrow vertical red and gray information blocks through the center and retain the small signature at lower left.
